summary: Max number of returns to depot to reload during a route.
range: Integer, default 1. Requires start_depot_ids. Conflicts with relations, layover_config, deadhead constraints.
constraints: Cannot combine with max_deadhead_distance/duration, layover_config, relations.
businessRules: max_depot_runs defines: Specify the maximum number of times the vehicle can return to the designated depot in order to reload items/cargo for completing additional tasks. Please note that: * start_depot_id is required for…
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.start_depot_ids. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Shipments: pickup always occurs before delivery on the route.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: max_depot_runs 2 lets a small vehicle reload and serve more demand.
Negative: max_depot_runs with layover_config also set -> 400.
Interaction: Positive: two depots north/south, demand split by region -> each vehicle serves its nearby cluster.
Interaction: Infeasible: job depot_ids incompatible with any vehicle's depots -> unassigned.
